' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO"; printf '%s

' "$START"; printf '%s
' "$START" | grep -q 'Status: ok'; APP=''; HELPER=''; for i in $(seq 1 80); do APP=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | tr -d ''); HELPER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | awk '$1=="shell" && $3 ~ /call_media$/ {print $2; exit}' | tr -d ''); if [ -n "$APP" ] && [ -n "$HELPER" ]; then break; fi; sleep 0.1; done; echo app_pid_before_death=$APP; echo helper_pid_before_death=$HELPER; test -n "$APP"; test -n "$HELPER"; MEDIA_ACTIVE=0; for i in $(seq 1 50); do SYSLOG=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief); if printf '%s
' "$SYSLOG" | grep -E "u/pid:2000/$HELPER state:started.*USAGE_CALL_ASSISTANT|USAGE_CALL_ASSISTANT.*u/pid:2000/$HELPER state:started" >/dev/null; then MEDIA_ACTIVE=1; break; fi; sleep 0.1; done; echo call_assistant_active_before_app_death=$MEDIA_ACTIVE; test "$MEDIA_ACTIVE" = "1"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "sh -c 'sleep 15; input keyevent KEYCODE_ENDCALL; cmd audio adj-mute 0; cmd audio adj-mute 8' >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null &"; PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 scripts/s22_app_death_gate.py --serial "$SERIAL" arm --app-pid "$APP" --helper-pid "$HELPER" --termination-method force-stop; sleep 5; PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 scripts/s22_app_death_gate.py --serial "$SERIAL" collect --max-cleanup-ms 3000; echo app_death_phone_observer_green=true; cleanup; trap - EXIT; for i in $(seq 1 20); do S=$(state); [ "$S" = "0" ] && break; sleep 0.25; done; test "$(state)" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | grep -E '^shell[[:space:]]+[0-9]+[[:space:]]+shizuku_server$'; echo milestone_d_app_death_physical_green=true
